summary: Iteration 23 — Re-verification of the 8 P0 + 2 P1 fixes from iteration 22. All 11 items PASS on the external preview URL across all 4 personas (super_admin, reseller, hr_admin, employee). Previously-broken CTAs (Check-in visitor, New booking) were confirmed working — iteration 22 likely missed them because the modals render as custom divs with data-testid='vm-modal' / 'rb-modal' instead of role='dialog'. Row-click navigations, in-app 404, permission guard on /app/expenses, expanded SA & Reseller sidebars, and reseller stubs all work as described.

critical_code_review_comments: Modal visibility detection in automation: Visitors and ResourceBooking use custom modal div with data-testid='<x>-modal' rather than role='dialog'. Iteration 22 used role='dialog' selector and reported false dead-button — recommend standardising all modals to expose role='dialog' (a11y win) or documenting the data-testid naming so future test agents don't report false negatives.

The Add-employee dialog fields use data-testid='dir-add-title' rather than the attribute name='job_title' mentioned in the request — functional equivalence is fine, but suggest aligning the data-testid naming with the backend field (e.g., 'dir-add-job-title').
seed_data_creation: None — modals opened and closed without submit (per iteration 22 convention).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-22 P0/P1 regressions are fixed. Not retested here (per scope): end-to-end save-and-persist of any of the newly wired modals (create company, create employee, letter PDF generation, visitor check-in persistence, resource booking persistence). Backend endpoints employment-class/config, employment-class/stats, posh/committee were trusted per main agent's curl confirmation and not re-hit from this agent. Scope for next run should be actual submit flows for: (a) dir-add-employee → verify employee appears in list + login created, (b) vm-modal → verify visitor appears in 'Today's visitors', (c) rb-modal → verify booking appears in Upcoming, (d) tmpl-use → verify PDF preview/download, (e) Companies/Resellers detail pages stats accuracy against live data.
rca of the issue: Iteration 22 reported Check-in visitor and New booking CTAs as 'dead'. Re-verification shows both handlers were correctly wired; the previous agent likely used a [role='dialog'] selector which does NOT match these components (they use custom div + data-testid). Modal-visibility detection in iteration 22 was a selector-mismatch false negative, not a real regression.
